rows.section: Tariff rules (Zug)
rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples, and single parents living alone with their children or supported persons, use the separate tariff (§ 35 Abs. 2 StG)
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Zug (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 35 StG

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Zug; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Zug; other communes in Zug set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Zug)
rows.label: Profit tax rate, companies, cooperatives and mainly commercial foundations
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Zug (Stand Februar 2026), Juristische Personen: Steuerberechnung, § 66 StG

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Zug)
rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Zug)
rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer)
rows.value: None as such: only land registry or transfer fees are charged (amounts not stored)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)
